title: Kengan Omega
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Two years after Kengan Ashura, young fighter Koga Narushima wants to enter the Kengan matches, in which wealthy companies settle business disputes through hired unarmed fighters, and he is also searching for Tokita Ohma. Working under Kazuo Yamashita, he meets Gaoh Ryuki, who looks exactly like Ohma, as a showdown builds between the Kengan Association and a rival underground fighting organization, Purgatory.
life_message: Strength, discipline and the courage to keep fighting earn respect and a place among the strongest.
